decision_timing: The replay registration was prospectively frozen before replay launch. This reporting-only amendment was created after replay child_started_utc=2026-09-02T04:36:54Z and does not claim or infer the time of the first replay OpenMM call. It was frozen before any new arc-length-500 energy or ODE--NEB diagnostic-force call for this densification.
purpose: Permit a prospectively fixed subset of fully evaluated current IR-IVM states to be retained for reporting without changing the online IR-IVM algorithm or feeding any reporting diagnostic back into optimization.

scope.method: selected Barnase--Barstar IR-IVM with alpha=1, r=0.1, m_max=5

scientific_eligibility.allowed: a nonterminal path recorded by the unchanged online runner at one of the fixed reporting calls, with a complete 32-image current path, finite discrete I_perp, a counter-bound actual optimization N_F, and exact online-history prefix agreement with the sealed selected 9990-N_F reference
scientific_eligibility.why_noncommitted_intermediate_states_are: reparameterization commitment is an online transaction label, not evidence that an ordinary recorded current path lacks energies or forces; the replay verifier must independently prove that every admitted record is fully evaluated and belongs to the exact selected trajectory
forbidden: the terminal appended path or any terminal uncommitted/partial charged tail
a rejected proposal that was not promoted to the current algorithm state
a path chosen after inspecting its new densified Delta E
a path from another hyperparameter setting
a path whose replay prefix differs from the sealed selected 9990-N_F reference

metric_and_cost_policy.left_metric: discrete unnormalized normal residual I_perp from the exact fully evaluated online record
metric_and_cost_policy.right_metric: densified 0 K forward barrier Delta E on 500 points uniformly spaced in unweighted Cartesian arc length along the same frozen piecewise-linear 32-image path, including both endpoints
metric_and_cost_policy.optimization_cost_axis: actual sum of successful physical joint energy/force cache misses over the 30 internal images at that record

selection_policy.IVM_rule: include every fixed legacy-storage milestone through call 50 and merge, by exact path identity and actual optimization N_F, with all previously registered selected-IR-IVM committed paths
selection_policy.ODE_NEB_rule: for each new IR-IVM actual optimization N_F, select the latest first occurrence of a distinct official retained ODE--NEB current path whose optimization N_F does not exceed that IR-IVM value
selection_policy.duplicate_retained_path_cost: earliest official optimization N_F at which the identical retained path first occurred
selection_policy.allowed_curve_claim: observed lower envelope and earliest observed first passage only
